name: Evanston Fall Favorites A 2025
information:
This competition is in series with [Evanston Fall Favorites B 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonFallFavoritesB2025), which will take place later in the day in the same venue. Competitors may only register for one of the two competitions. In addition, this is a favorites competition, meaning that each person may register for a maximum of four events. See the [Registration and Waitlist](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonFallFavoritesA2025#64840-registration-and-waitlist) tab for more details.

Please read all tabs before registering. If you have not been to Northwestern before, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
